tracks.title: 摩天輪 Môo-thian-lûn
tracks.mood: giddy, shy and a little scheming
tracks.subject: a woman who plans to propose at the top of a seventeen-minute Ferris wheel ride and finds her boyfriend too scared of heights to open his eyes
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien 1930s ryukoka revival, an early-1930s Taiwanese salon foxtrot. Violin and mandolin playing the melody in unison; a clarinet countermelody between the vocal phrases; upright piano comping on the off-beats; upright bass in a two-beat foxtrot; a light period dance-band drum set with woodblock and brushed snare. Small-room sound, narrow and slightly band-limited like an old 78 record but clean, the vocal close and forward. Light, clear female soprano with precise diction and a slight shimmer of vibrato, bright and coquettish phrasing. 116 BPM, G major. Giddy, shy and a little scheming. No big-band horn section, no swing ride cymbal, no enka kobushi or sobbing, no modern drum kit, no trap hi-hats, no synth, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
禮拜六 暗時七點
摩天輪 一輾十七分
戒指 藏佇我的皮包底
我算好 上懸彼一分鐘

[Pre-Chorus]
伊講 伊無驚懸
規雙跤 煞咇咇掣

[Chorus]
一輾十七分 慢慢仔起
車廂 搖一下 伊喝一聲
目睭瞌牢牢 手共我掠牢牢
戒指 猶藏佇皮包底

[Verse]
落來 我閣買兩張票
伊面青青 講「好啊 無要緊」
講稿 我佇心內 唸幾若遍
車廂 閣慢慢仔 起去上懸

[Pre-Chorus]
伊講 伊無驚懸
喙 煞一直唸阿彌陀佛

[Chorus]
一輾十七分 慢慢仔起

伊的目睭 猶瞌牢牢

伊無看 就講「好!」

[Chorus]
一輾十七分 慢慢仔落

[Outro]

tracks.title: 奶矸 Ling-kan
tracks.mood: tender, sleepy and a little proud
tracks.subject: a new father's three a.m. bottle feed in a dark kitchen while the mother finally sleeps
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien lullaby, a rocking 6/8 cradle song in the traditional Taiwanese style. A music-box ostinato on a simple pentatonic figure; nylon-string guitar arpeggios in 6/8; a soft cello pedal tone; felt-piano chords entering in the bridge. Hushed, dry and close, as if sung beside a baby's ear, the voice forward and everything else low. Soft, low male voice, intimate near-whisper singing with long exhaled phrase endings. 66 BPM, F major. Tender, sleepy and a little proud at three in the morning. No drums, no bass guitar, no string swell, no pop chorus build, no children's choir, no autotune.

tracks.title: 虱目魚 Sat-ba̍k-hî
tracks.mood: cheeky haggling that both sides enjoy
tracks.subject: a fishmonger and a sharp-tongued auntie haggling over a milkfish belly in rhymed seven-syllable banter at a morning market
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien tshia-koo song-dance in the rustic street-theatre banter style, brisk 2/4. A coconut-shell fiddle and a large two-string fiddle playing the tune in unison; a moon lute strummed in quick downstrokes; a bamboo flute countermelody; four bamboo clappers and a small hand gong carrying the rhythm over a light upright bass. Lively and close, dry, the clappers and the two voices forward. A comic male voice and a bright female head voice trading short rhymed lines in quick syllabic delivery, laughter in their voices, joining together on the chorus. 120 BPM, A major. Cheeky haggling that both sides enjoy. No drum kit, no electric guitar, no synth, no slow nanguan chamber singing, no autotune.

tracks.title: หมวกใบที่สอง (The Second Helmet)
tracks.genre: Central Thai luk thung ballad (Suphan Buri style)
tracks.mood: aching and loyal
tracks.subject: keeping a boyfriend's helmet hooked on the scooter in Suphan Buri for the two years he works in a Korean factory
tracks.caption: Central Thai luk thung ballad in the Suphan Buri style of the Phumphuang lineage. A muted trumpet and an alto sax answering each vocal line with short sighing phrases; a clean electric guitar with tremolo-picked fills between lines; an accordion-voiced organ pad holding the chords; a string section swelling into each chorus; an electric bass alternating root and fifth in the two-beat luk thung pattern. Light kit drums with a rim snare and small ching cymbals on the off-beat. Warm and roomy like a live country-music stage, the voice far forward and the horns just behind it. Female voice, a Central Thai luk thung singer with long uean melisma held on the line endings, wide vibrato and a small sob-break on the tender words. 76 BPM, D minor. Aching and loyal, waiting with a spare helmet. No khaen, no phin, no Isan lam phrasing, no luk krung big-band swing, no trap drums, no autotune, no pop ballad piano.

[Intro - short muted trumpet phrase and tremolo guitar over a string swell]

ใครขอซ้อนท้าย ฉันบอกที่นั่งมีเจ้าของ
ติดไฟแดงหน้าอำเภอ ฉันยังเผลอหันไปมอง
เหมือนพี่ยังนั่งซ้อน กอดเอวฉันอยู่ข้างหลัง

[Chorus]
หมวกใบที่สอง ฉันยังไม่ให้ใครยืม
ใครขอซ้อนท้าย ฉันบอกที่นั่งมีเจ้าของ
อีกหนึ่งหน้าหนาว ที่ท่ารถฉันจะรอ
ถือหมวกใบนี้ไป ให้พี่ขี่ ฉันซ้อนกลับบ้าน

สามทุ่มแล้ว โทรมานะพี่
หมวกยังแขวนอยู่ที่เดิม

tracks.title: ที่นอนยังอุ่น (Still Warm)
tracks.mood: sleepy, devoted and still smitten at seven in the morning
tracks.subject: a young married couple on opposite shifts sharing one rented room in Bang Na, she home from a bakery night shift at half past six, he leaving for a building site at seven, and the half hour at the door that is their whole day together
tracks.caption: Thai melodic chopper rap, a harmonised fast-flow love rap in the Bone Thugs-n-Harmony lineage. A looping nylon-string guitar figure and warm Rhodes chords; a round, warm sub bass; a dry boom-bap kick with the snare on two and four and straight eighth-note hi-hats; a soft string pad entering in the second hook. Dry, close and intimate, the voice and guitar loop forward with plenty of space around the drums. Male voice, rapid double-time triplet chopper verses in a soft natural speaking tone, switching to stacked self-harmonised sung hooks with a second male voice singing the short answers, no pitch correction. 76 BPM, D-flat major. Sleepy, devoted and still smitten at seven in the morning. No trap hi-hat rolls, no 808 slides, no autotune, no R&B slow-jam croon, no shouted street bars, no EDM drop.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - nylon guitar loop and Rhodes, short]

[Verse 1]
หกโมงครึ่งเสียงกุญแจไขประตู ผมรู้ว่าเธอกลับจากกะดึกที่ร้านเบเกอรี่
แป้งขาวติดปลายผม กลิ่นเนยติดเสื้อ เธอยื่นขนมปังเมื่อวานให้ผมหนึ่งถุงใหญ่
เธอเล่าเร็วๆ เตาอบตัวที่สามพังอีกแล้ว ครัวซองต์ไหม้ไปสองถาด เจ๊บ่นจนฟ้าสาง
ผมฟังไปผูกเชือกรองเท้าบู๊ตไป เข็มนาฬิกาบนฝาห้องวิ่งเร็วกว่าทุกวัน

[Hook]
ที่นอนยังอุ่น (ยังอุ่นอยู่)
ผมเว้นไว้ให้เธอ ตรงที่ผมเพิ่งลุก
ที่นอนยังอุ่น (ยังอุ่นอยู่)
ครึ่งชั่วโมงหน้าประตู คือทั้งวันของเรา

[Verse 2]
เจ็ดโมงผมขึ้นนั่งร้านชั้นเก้า ไซต์คอนโดบางนา ฝุ่นปูนลอยทั้งเช้า
เที่ยงผมเปิดถุงขนมปัง เจอลายมือเธอบนถุง กินน้ำเยอะๆ นะเว้ย
บ่ายสามส่งสติกเกอร์หมีไปตัวหนึ่ง รู้ว่าเธอยังหลับ คงไม่มีใครอ่าน
หกโมงสิบห้าเธอออกไปเข้ากะ หกโมงครึ่งผมถึงห้อง สวนกันแค่สิบห้านาที

[Hook]
ที่นอนยังอุ่น (ยังอุ่นอยู่)
เธอเว้นไว้ให้ผม ตรงที่เธอเพิ่งลุก
ที่นอนยังอุ่น (ยังอุ่นอยู่)
มีกลิ่นเนยติดหมอน เหมือนเธอยังนอนตรงนี้

[Outro - Rhodes and sub only]
วันอาทิตย์ร้านเธอปิด
เราตั้งนาฬิกาปลุกไว้ แต่ไม่มีใครลุก

tracks.title: ผีสวนยาง (Rubber Grove Ghost)
tracks.genre: Southern Thai string sator luk thung
tracks.mood: scared silly, then sheepish
tracks.subject: a rubber tapper at two in the morning sure a ghost is knocking over his latex cups, until his head torch finds the neighbour's goat
tracks.caption: Southern Thai luk thung in the phleng tai string sator style, a band-based dance song. A short pi reed-oboe riff as the intro hook and between choruses; a twangy clean electric lead guitar with fast picked fills; keyboard brass stabs on the off-beats; a bouncy electric bass; kit drums with a busy snare, layered with thap goblet-drum slaps, klong tuk accents and a low mong gong hit at the end of each phrase. Live, dry and bright like an outdoor temple-fair stage, the voice and the pi forward. Male voice, fast and clipped in Southern Thai dialect with short melisma, and the band shouting comic asides in the voice of a shadow-puppet clown. 124 BPM, G major. Scared silly, then sheepish. No khaen, no Isan phrasing, no trap drums, no autotune, no EDM synths.

tracks.title: ฝั่งนี้ (This Side)
tracks.genre: ramwong yon yuk temple-fair circle dance
tracks.mood: cheeky and competitive
tracks.subject: a ramwong band at a temple fair trying to win the crowd back from the likay stage across the yard, until the likay hero comes over after his show, still in make-up, and buys a coupon
tracks.caption: Ramwong yon yuk, a retro Central Thai temple-fair circle-dance song. Thon and rammana hand drums carrying the 2/4 ramwong beat; ching cymbals marking every beat, with chap clashes and krap wooden clacks; a thin, slightly cheap-sounding combo organ playing the melody; a plain electric bass on root and fifth; a single tenor sax answering the vocal lines. Live and roomy with a crowd-on-stage feel, the hand drums and the voice forward. Female voice, a bright ramwong band singer in natural Central Thai, cheeky and competitive, with a mixed crowd shouting the answer lines back. 116 BPM, F major. Cheeky and competitive under pink neon. No sam-cha rhythm, no marching brass band, no kit drums, no likay piphat ensemble, no trap, no autotune, no EDM.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - thon drum and ching, combo organ melody]

[Verse 1]
คืนนี้งานวัดมีสองเวที ไฟนีออนสีชมพูฝั่งเรา
ฝั่งโน้นลิเกพระเอกเสื้อเลื่อม แม่ยกล้อมเต็มหน้าโรง
คนดูเดินไปเดินมา เหมือนลูกปิงปองกลางลาน
หนูบอกมือออร์แกน เร่งเสียงขึ้นอีกขีดเดียว

[Chorus - crowd answers]
มารำวงฝั่งนี้พี่ (ฝั่งนี้ ฝั่งนี้)
ลิเกร้องยาวครึ่งชั่วโมง (ฝั่งนี้เพลงละสามนาที)
ฉิ่งตีไปตั้งร้อยที คูปองใบละยี่สิบ
ไม่ต้องรอพระเอก มารำกับหนูก่อน

[Verse 2]
ฝั่งลิเกเปิดลำโพงสู้ เสียงพระเอกดังลั่นวัด
แม่ยกยังเอาพวงมาลัย มาคล้องคอพระเอกทีละพวง
หนูชวนคนขายลูกชิ้นปิ้ง ขึ้นมารำกลางวง
คนดูหัวเราะหันมามอง เดินกลับมาทั้งแถว

[Chorus - crowd answers]
มารำวงฝั่งนี้พี่ (ฝั่งนี้ ฝั่งนี้)
ลิเกร้องยาวครึ่งชั่วโมง (ฝั่งนี้เพลงละสามนาที)
ลิเกจบตอนตีหนึ่ง พระเอกยังไม่ล้างหน้า
เดินมาซื้อคูปองหนู รำสวยกว่าหนูอีก

[Outro - thon drum alone, crowd laughing]
พรุ่งนี้มาอีกนะพี่ (มาอีกนะพี่)
ลิเกกับรำวง เวทีเดียวกันเลย

tracks.title: วิทยุเสีย (Radio's Broken)
tracks.mood: happily in love, windows down
tracks.subject: driving from Bangkok to Hua Hin on a Friday night in a car with a dead radio, the two of you singing every song yourselves and missing the high notes
tracks.caption: Thai city pop, a jazz-chord boogie in the Polycat lineage. A tight slap bass playing a syncopated boogie line; a Rhodes electric piano layered with a DX7-style FM electric piano on maj7 and min9 chords and secondary dominants; a clean funk guitar playing sixteenth-note chops; a trumpet and saxophone section with short stabs at the end of each chorus line; live drums with a disco open hi-hat and a backbeat on two and four. Warm, clean and wide, the bass and the voice forward, the guitar panned to one side. Male voice, a light clean tenor with a breezy falsetto chorus, relaxed and smiling. 110 BPM, E major. Happily in love on a night drive with the windows down. No synth lead, no rap verse, no trap drums, no autotune, no EDM drop.

tracks.title: รถเกี่ยวคันแดง (Red Harvester)
tracks.mood: proud, loud and in charge
tracks.subject: the only woman in a Surin district who drives a combine harvester, and the men who said she couldn't now queueing to book her first
tracks.caption: Kantrum rock, the electric Northern Khmer dance music of Surin. A tro fiddle playing a sawing, nasal lead that shadows the vocal; a kantrum goblet drum in fast interlocking hand patterns; ching and krap wooden clappers keeping time; an overdriven electric guitar doubling the fiddle riff; electric bass and a rock kit with a driving kick under the hand drums. Loud, dry and raw like a village concert stage, the fiddle, the goblet drum and the voice forward. Female voice, ornamented nasal folk singing with fast melisma and proud, shouted phrase endings, a group of men answering the hook lines. 136 BPM, A minor. Proud, loud and in charge. No khaen, no phin, no mor lam phrasing, no luk thung brass, no pop ballad, no trap drums, no autotune, no EDM.

tracks.title: ตัวสำรอง (The Sub)
tracks.mood: nervous, proud and giddy
tracks.subject: a school troupe's drum carrier who gets to play lead pong lang at the Kalasin festival because the regular player broke his arm falling out of a mango tree
tracks.caption: Pong lang ensemble song from Kalasin, the sound of an Isan folk-dance troupe. A wooden pong lang log xylophone as the lead, bright and dry, two players, one on the melody and one on paired-note harmony; a wot circular bamboo panpipe doubling the melody; a long hand drum with ching and chap cymbals driving the dance; a jar-bass thump under an electric bass; phin and khaen kept quiet in support. Bright, dry and percussive with outdoor festival air, the xylophone and the group voices forward. A young male lead singing in Isan dialect, with a troupe of mixed voices answering in unison, and long instrumental breaks for dancing. 132 BPM, G major. Nervous, proud and giddy. No khaen solo lead, no electric phin lead, no mor lam sing-speech, no luk thung brass, no trap drums, no synths, no autotune, no pop ballad.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - pong lang xylophone pair and wot panpipe, ching]

[Verse 1]
สองปีข่อยแบกกลองยาว ย่างตามหลังวงโรงเรียน
ครูบอกใจเย็นๆ เด้อหล่า ถ่าไปก่อน
บ่าวต้นมือโปงลางเอก ปีนต้นมะม่วงหลังโรงอาหาร
กิ่งหักแขนหักสองท่อน สามมื้อก่อนงานใหญ่

[Chorus - troupe answers in unison]
ตัวสำรองขึ้นเวที (ขึ้นแล้ว ขึ้นแล้ว)
มือสั่นจนไม้ตีกระทบกันกึกๆ
ตีลายแมงภู่ตอมดอก (ม่วนคักหลาย)
แม่ยืนเบิ่งอยู่หน้าเวที

[Verse 2]
งานโปงลางแพรวาที่กาฬสินธุ์ คนเต็มสนามหน้าศาลากลาง
ข่อยจำโน้ตได้ทุกตัว แต่ลืมว่าต้องยิ้ม
บ่าวต้นใส่เฝือกนั่งแถวหน้า ชูแขนข้างดีเชียร์ข่อย
ตีลายลมพัดพร้าว ไม้หลุดมือเทื่อเดียว

[Chorus - troupe answers in unison]
ตัวสำรองขึ้นเวที (ขึ้นแล้ว ขึ้นแล้ว)
มือบ่สั่นแล้วเด้อครู
ไม้หลุดไปตกใส่กลองยาว (บ่เป็นหยัง)
ข่อยเก็บมาตีต่อจนจบเพลง

[Instrumental Break - pong lang and wot trade the melody over the long drum]

[Outro - xylophone pair alone]
ปีหน้าบ่าวต้นแขนหายดี
ข่อยสิขอตีคู่กับเขา

tracks.title: ผิงไฟเช้าแรก (First Cold Morning)
tracks.mood: tender and sleepy, warming hands
tracks.subject: the first cold morning of the year in a Lampang lane, when the neighbours light a fire of dry leaves in a yard and an old man brings out his sueng
tracks.caption: Lanna kham muang folksong in the classic Northern Thai acoustic style. A fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitar in a slow rolling pattern; a sueng Northern lute playing tremolo lines between the verses; a salo fiddle answering the vocal phrases; a pi chum free-reed pipe playing the intro melody; very light hand percussion and no kit. Close, quiet and warm, like a small porch recording on a cold morning, the voice and the guitar forward. Male voice, soft and unhurried, storytelling in Northern Thai dialect with a gentle, slightly husky tone and small ornaments. 84 BPM, D major. Tender and sleepy, warming hands by a leaf fire. No drum kit, no electric guitar, no harmonica, no songs-for-life strummed folk rock, no Isan phrasing, no pop ballad strings, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - pi chum reed pipe and fingerpicked acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1]
เจ้านี้หมอกลงขาวเต็มข่วงบ้าน
ไก่ขันแล้ว บ่มีไผอยากลุกจากผ้าห่ม
ป้าบัวคำกวาดใบตองตึงมากองไว้
ขีดไม้ขีดก้านเดียว ไฟก็ลุกพรึ่บ

[Chorus]
มาผิงไฟกั๋นเต๊อะ จาวบ้านเหย
เอามืออังไฟ อู้กั๋นจักหน่อย
ข้าวนึ่งปั้นก้อน ปิ้งไฟจนเหลือง
หนาวปีนี้มาแล้ว มานั่งใกล้ๆ กั๋น

[Verse 2]
อุ้ยแก้วบ้านท้ายซอย ถือสึงออกมา
ดีดเพลงเก่าตี้เปิ้นเล่นตอนหนุ่มๆ
ป้าบัวคำนั่งฟัง ควันไฟเข้าตา
น้ำตาไหลพอดี บ่มีไผถามว่าไห้เพราะอะหยัง

[Chorus]
มาผิงไฟกั๋นเต๊อะ จาวบ้านเหย
เอามืออังไฟ อู้กั๋นจักหน่อย
ไฟใกล้มอดแล้ว เติมใบตองตึงอีกกอง
อุ้ยแก้วยังดีดบ่หยุด บ่มีไผลุกไปไหน

[Outro - sueng tremolo alone]
แดดขึ้นแล้ว หมอกก็จาง
ขี้เถ้ากองนี้ พรุ่งนี้ก่อใหม่

tracks.title: สายแปด (Bus 8)
tracks.mood: soaked, furious, then laughing
tracks.subject: a number 8 bus splashing your only ironed white shirt on the way to a job interview, and the interviewer's first question
tracks.caption: Thai ska in the T-Bone lineage, a fast two-step led by a horn line. An offbeat upstroke electric guitar skank; an organ bubble; a running walking bass; a horn section of tenor sax, alto sax and trumpet playing unison riffs and harmony answers to the hook; fast two-step drums with rim clicks and open hi-hat lifts. Live, bright and punchy, the horns and the voice forward, the band slightly roomy. Male voice, an upbeat sing-shout lead with a laughing edge, and a gang chorus shouting the answer lines. 164 BPM, B-flat major. Soaked, furious, then laughing. No reggae one-drop, no distorted punk guitars, no trap, no autotune, no EDM.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - horn section unison riff, offbeat guitar skank]

[Verse 1]
เก้าโมงสัมภาษณ์งาน ผมรีดเสื้อขาวตัวเดียวตั้งแต่ตีห้า
ฝนตกทั้งคืน ถนนหน้าป้ายกลายเป็นคลอง
ยืนห่างขอบทางสองเมตร กอดแฟ้มเอกสารไว้แนบอก
แล้วสายแปดก็มาเต็มสปีด บีบแตรมาไม่ลดเลย

[Chorus - gang shouts]
สายแปด! (สายแปด!)
น้ำโคลนทั้งถนน มาอยู่บนเสื้อผม
สายแปด! (สายแปด!)
คนขับยังยิ้มให้ แล้วจอดเลยป้ายไปอีกร้อยเมตร

[Instrumental Break - tenor sax solo over the offbeat skank]

[Verse 2]
ผมวิ่งไล่ไปจนทัน ขึ้นรถทั้งที่ตัวยังหยดติ๋งๆ
กระเป๋ารถเมล์ยื่นทิชชู่ให้ห่อหนึ่ง บอกใจเย็นนะน้อง
นั่งเปียกไปจนถึงตึก เข้าห้องสัมภาษณ์ทั้งตัวเลอะ
ผู้จัดการถามคำแรก ว่าน้องมาสายอะไร

[Chorus - gang shouts]
สายแปด! (สายแปด!)
ผมตอบเสียงดังลั่น ทั้งที่ยังเปียกโคลน
สายแปด! (สายแปด!)
เขาหัวเราะจนน้ำตาไหล บอกพรุ่งนี้มาเริ่มงาน

[Bridge - horns drop out, bass and skank only]
เขาบอกเขาก็นั่งสายแปด มาทุกเช้าห้าปีเต็ม
โดนไปแล้วสามตัว เชิ้ตขาวสอง กางเกงหนึ่ง
เปิดลิ้นชักโต๊ะทำงาน มีเสื้อขาวสำรองพับไว้
ยื่นให้ผมหนึ่งตัว บอกเก็บไว้ใช้วันฝนตก

[Outro - horns hit, drums cut]
พรุ่งนี้เจ็ดโมงครึ่ง ที่ป้ายเดิม
ผมจะยืนห่างขอบทาง สามเมตร
[Song ends abruptly]

tracks.title: เจ็ดเสียง (Seven Tones)
tracks.mood: obsessive, sleepy, quietly triumphant
tracks.subject: re-tuning a second-hand ranat ek bought online at midnight, adding and scraping the wax-and-lead lumps under its twenty-one bars by ear, because the phone tuner only knows twelve notes and the Thai scale has seven equal steps
tracks.caption: Thai math rock with post-rock swells and sparse vocals. A clean tapped and arpeggiated electric guitar in 7/8, ringing and bright; a busy melodic electric bass answering the guitar; tight dry drums with metric shifts between 7/8 and 4/4; a muted trumpet line and a kalimba figure in the instrumental build. Clean and dry, the guitars wide and every part audible, building to a swell without distortion. Female voice, soft and half-spoken, close to the microphone, a few words at a time, entering after a short intro, with instrumental passages between. 136 BPM, F-sharp minor. Obsessive, sleepy and quietly triumphant. No distortion walls, no screaming, no four-on-the-floor beat, no trap, no autotune, no big pop chorus.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - short clean tapped guitar figure in 7/8, bass answering]

[Verse 1]
ระนาดเอกมือสอง ยี่สิบเอ็ดลูก
ซื้อมาจากเพจ ส่งมาถึงเสียงเพี้ยน
ขี้ผึ้งผสมตะกั่ว ใต้หัวท้ายลูกระนาด
เติมนิดเสียงต่ำ ขูดออกเสียงสูง

[Chorus]
แอปจูนเนอร์ บอกว่าผิด
มันรู้จักแค่สิบสองเสียง
ระนาดไทยมีเจ็ด ห่างเท่ากัน
ฉันฟังเอง ทีละลูก

[Verse 2]
เที่ยงคืนเปิดคลิปครูตีเพลงเดิม
ตีตามทีละโน้ต ลูกที่สิบสี่ยังเพี้ยน
ขูดออกอีกนิด ด้วยไม้จิ้มฟัน
ตีอีกที แล้วก็นิ่ง

[Bridge - odd-meter build, muted trumpet and kalimba]

[Chorus]
แอปจูนเนอร์ บอกว่าผิด
มันรู้จักแค่สิบสองเสียง
ลูกสุดท้ายดังตรงกับครู
ฉันวางไม้ตี แล้วก็ยิ้ม

[Outro - guitar figure slows and stops]
ตีหนึ่งยี่สิบ ไล่เสียงครบหนึ่งรอบ
แล้วก็หลับไป บนพื้นข้างระนาด

tracks.title: đầu lân là của tôi
tracks.mood: fierce and cocky, a cymbal girl taking the lion's head
tracks.subject: the first girl her ward's lion-dance troupe lets try out for the lion's head, and the Mid-Autumn night she has to keep to the drummer's beat on top of benches stacked three high
tracks.caption: Vietnamese performance dance-pop in the Anh Trai Say Hi stage style, EDM drops fused with half-time trap verses. A stacked supersaw lead with heavy sidechain pumping carrying each drop; a short synth-pluck key hook played between vocal lines; a big-room kick over a deep 808 sub in the drops; half-time trap verses with 1/32 hi-hat rolls and the snare on beat three; white-noise risers, reverse cymbals and impact hits marking every build. Loud, compressed and wide in the drops with the kick and the unison crew shouts forward, the verses drier and closer. A bright, cocky female lead with a teasing grin in her delivery, a mixed crew of male and female troupe voices shouting the answer lines in unison, and one short rapped bridge over a filtered beat. 128 BPM, F minor. Fierce and cocky, a cymbal girl taking the lion's head. No ballad section, no acoustic guitar, no hard autotune, no lo-fi texture, no reggaeton beat, no Vinahouse pitch-bent bass.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - supersaw swell and synth-pluck hook, short]

[Verse 1 - half-time trap beat]
Đội lân phường Bảy, mười năm toàn con trai
Ba mùa Trung Thu tôi đứng cuối hàng, cầm đôi chập chõa
Năm nay anh múa đầu lân lên Sài Gòn đi học
Chú trưởng đoàn nhìn quanh, rồi nhìn đôi giày ba ta của tôi

[Pre-Chorus - riser]
“Đầu lân nặng năm ký, con gái cầm nổi không?”
Cho con một tháng, đêm rằm chú tự xem

[Chorus - drop, crew shouts]
Đầu lân là của tôi (Của ai? Của tôi!)
Trống anh Khoa đánh, chân tôi theo từng tiếng (Tùng! Cắc! Tùng!)
Băng ghế chồng ba tầng, mắt lân chớp
Cả phường ngước lên, nhìn cho kỹ

[Verse 2]
Đêm đầu tôi té khỏi ghế, đầu lân lăn ra tới cổng đình
Vai tôi tím hai bên, mẹ bôi dầu gió mà không nói câu nào
Thằng Bin cầm đuôi, nắm lưng quần tôi, tay nó run hơn tôi
Anh Khoa gõ dùi vào vành trống: “nghe trống, đừng nhìn chân”

[Chorus - drop, crew shouts]
Đầu lân là của tôi (Của ai? Của tôi!)
Trống anh Khoa đánh, chân tôi theo từng tiếng (Tùng! Cắc! Tùng!)
Băng ghế chồng ba tầng, mắt lân chớp
Chú trưởng đoàn đứng dưới, điếu thuốc tắt lúc nào không hay

[Bridge - rap over a filtered beat]
Tầng một, tầng hai, tầng ba cao ngang mái tôn
Gió rằm thổi ngang, Bin đỡ eo, tôi bám theo dùi trống
Trống dồn thì tôi lắc, trống ngừng thì tôi đứng
Ông Địa dưới sân phe phẩy quạt, cười như biết trước rồi

[Outro - last drop, then the supersaw fades]
Xuống ghế, tôi tháo đầu lân, tóc bết hết vào trán
Mấy đứa nhỏ xếp hàng: “chị ơi, cho em cầm thử”

tracks.title: mở cửa lại ngày thứ tư
tracks.mood: hopeful and earnest, mud up to the knees
tracks.subject: a couple washing flood mud out of their Hội An lantern shop and reopening on the fourth day with the forty lanterns that survived and one lopsided new one
tracks.caption: Vietnamese film-soundtrack pop-rock anthem in the style of a cinema OST duet. A clean electric guitar playing a ringing arpeggio over bright piano chords in the intro and verses; the full band enters at the chorus with overdriven rhythm guitar on eighth-note power chords, a live drum kit with open hi-hats and a crash on each downbeat, and picked electric bass; a drum-fill build and a half-time breakdown before a cinematic string pad swells into the last chorus. Intimate and close in the verses, wide and loud in the choruses, the guitars and the two voices forward. A male and a female voice in duet, trading lines and singing close harmony in the verses, both belting in chest voice with gang backing vocals in the final chorus. 92 BPM, D major. Hopeful and earnest, mud up to the knees. No EDM drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap verse, no metal screaming.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - clean guitar arpeggio and piano, short]

[Verse 1 - Male]
Nước rút lúc năm giờ sáng, để lại vạch bùn ngang đầu gối
Anh kéo cửa tiệm, cái cửa sắt kêu như ông già ho
Ba trăm chiếc đèn lồng nằm trong bùn, đỏ thành nâu
Anh đứng nhìn lâu, em bảo: “đứng nữa là bùn khô đấy”

[Verse 1 - Female]
Em kéo vòi nước từ nhà bác Sáu bên cạnh
Anh cào, em xịt, hai đứa không nói câu nào

[Chorus - Duet, full band]
Mình mở cửa lại ngày thứ tư
Còn bốn mươi chiếc, phơi dọc sợi dây trước hiên
Ai đi ngang cũng hỏi: “bán chưa?”
Mình nói chưa, nhưng mai thì có

[Verse 2 - Female]
Ngày thứ hai mất điện, mình ăn mì gói nấu bằng bếp cồn
Ngày thứ ba anh ngủ gục trên cái ghế nhựa ướt
Em lấy khung tre cũ, dán lụa mới, tay em run
Chiếc đầu tiên méo xệch, anh vẫn treo nó ở giữa

[Bridge - half-time, drums build]
Anh không biết nói câu nào cho hay
Anh chỉ biết sáng mai anh lại cào bùn cùng em

[Chorus - Duet, gang vocals, strings]
Mình mở cửa lại ngày thứ tư
Giờ có bốn mươi mốt chiếc, chiếc méo treo ở giữa
Ai đi ngang cũng hỏi: “bán chưa?”
Mình nói bán, trừ cái méo kia

[Outro - clean guitar, band drops out]
Tối đó cả phố lên đèn

tracks.title: ai bấm chuông nhà ông Chín
tracks.mood: cheeky and jittery, an alley gang daring each other
tracks.subject: a gang of alley kids counting out with the xỉa cá mè đồng dao rhyme to pick who has to ring grumpy old Mr. Chín's gate bell and ask for their shuttlecock back off his tin roof
tracks.caption: Vietnamese playground-chant pop built on đồng dao children's rhymes and the xỉa cá mè counting-out game. Hand-clap game patterns and finger snaps on the off-beats; a mõ wooden temple block and trống cơm rice-paste drum slaps as the top percussion; toy-like pizzicato synth plucks doubled by marimba playing a sing-song melody; a bouncy straight-eighths kids'-pop kick and snare with a clap on every backbeat under the choruses; a spoken counting-rhyme break over claps alone before the full beat drops back in. Bright, dry and close, claps and woodblock forward, a small round bass. A playful, cheeky female lead in a light chest voice, answered line by line by a male voice, the two chanting the counting rhymes in call-and-response. 112 BPM, G major. Cheeky and jittery, an alley gang daring each other. No belted ballad notes, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no orchestral strings, no EDM supersaw drop, no reggaeton dembow.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - hand claps and woodblock, short]

[Verse 1]
Bốn giờ chiều hẻm mười hai, thằng Tí đá một phát hết chân
Quả cầu lông gà văng qua cổng, nằm chỏng chơ trên mái tôn nhà ông Chín
Ông Chín khó nhất hẻm, cổng sắt sơn xanh, con chó tên Mực
Năm đứa đứng dồn vào nhau, chẳng đứa nào dám bước lên

[Chorus - call and response]
Xỉa cá mè, đè cá chép! (Chân ai? Chân ai?)
Chân ai còn lại thì đi bấm chuông
Đếm từ trái, đếm từ phải (Đếm lại! Đếm lại!)
Chân nào cuối cùng là chân ra cổng

[Verse 2]
Ván đầu ra chân con Bống, nó mếu: “em mới bảy tuổi”
Ván hai ra chân thằng Tí, nó cãi chân đó là chân trái
Ván ba tôi rụt chân vào, cả bọn la lên: “ăn gian!”
Ván tư ra đúng chân tôi, đôi dép tổ ong còn dính đất

[Bridge - spoken counting rhyme over claps]
Mười bàn chân, một quả cầu, một con chó, một cái chuông
Bấm một cái, chạy về hay đứng lại, đứng lại hay chạy về

[Verse 3]
Tôi bấm chuông, con Mực sủa, cả bọn nấp sau cột điện
Ông Chín ra, áo ba lỗ, tay cầm cây sào phơi đồ
Ông khều một cái, rơi xuống bốn quả cầu, ba quả từ hè năm ngoái
Quả của tụi tôi ông đỡ bằng gót, tâng ba cái, đá trả qua cổng

[Chorus - call and response, full beat]
Xỉa cá mè, đè cá chép! (Chân ai? Chân ai?)
Chân ai còn lại thì vào đội ông Chín
Đếm từ trái, đếm từ phải (Đếm lại! Đếm lại!)
Chân nào cuối cùng là chân ra cổng

[Outro - claps drop out]
Ông bảo hồi xưa ông đá cầu nhất cái phố này
Chiều mai năm giờ ông mở cổng, đứa nào đá lên mái thì tự trèo

tracks.caption: Vietnamese electropop leaning into electro-house, the 2026 Saigon club-pop sound. A four-on-the-floor kick with a hard clap on two and four and open hi-hats on the off-beats; a growling detuned Reese bass line under distorted saw-bass stabs; detuned poly-synth chord stabs on the off-beats; a filtered build with a snare roll into each chorus; gated synth swells and glitch stutters on the synths only, for transitions. Dry, tight and loud, the kick and the Reese bass forward, the chord stabs spread wide. A cool, wry male voice, half-spoken and flat in the verses, lifting into a short chanted chorus with doubled ad-libs answering him. 124 BPM, A minor. Wry and quietly furious. No slap bass, no Rhodes, no trap hi-hats, no hard autotune, no ballad breakdown, no Vinahouse pitch-bent bass.

tracks.title: thả giỏ xuống đi em
tracks.mood: sentimental and openly smitten
tracks.subject: a student sending chicken rice porridge up to a feverish girl on the fourth floor of the girls' dorm in a plastic basket she lowers on a rope, after the guard will not let him in
tracks.caption: Vietnamese early-2000s nhạc trẻ love pop, a deliberate Y2K revival. Nylon-string guitar playing soft arpeggios under the verses; a General MIDI-style keyboard string pad and a glassy bell piano doubling the hook; a programmed R&B-lite drum loop with a rimshot snare and sixteenth-note shaker; a smooth fretless-style synth bass sliding between roots; a truck-driver key change up a whole step into the last chorus. Small and warm, mid-range forward, a light chorus-reverb sheen like a 2003 home studio, nothing booming. Smooth male lead, breathy and close in the verses, lifting into falsetto on the hook, with a stacked harmony chorus behind him. 84 BPM, E-flat major. Sentimental and openly smitten. No trap hi-hats, no EDM drop, no autotune, no big power-ballad drums, no rap verse.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - nylon guitar and bell piano, short]

[Verse 1]
Ký túc xá nữ, chú bảo vệ lắc đầu
“Con trai không được lên, cháo cũng không lên”
Anh đứng dưới sân, hộp cháo gà còn nóng
Em nhắn: “anh đợi chút, em đi tìm sợi dây”

[Pre-Chorus]
Tầng bốn, cửa sổ thứ ba tính từ trái
Một cái giỏ nhựa xanh thả xuống từng chút một

[Chorus - falsetto lift]
Em ơi, thả giỏ xuống đi
Hộp cháo gà, hai viên hạ sốt, một quả cam
Kéo chậm thôi, đừng để nghiêng
Em ơi, thả giỏ xuống đi em

[Verse 2]
Lần đầu anh nấu cháo, gạo khê mất một nửa
Mẹ anh đọc qua điện thoại, anh nêm theo từng câu
Cái giỏ đi lên, ngang cửa sổ tầng ba
Cô bé phòng dưới thò đầu ra: “cho em xin một thìa”

[Bridge - nylon guitar alone]
Mười phút sau cái giỏ lại xuống
Hộp không, kèm mẩu giấy: “mai anh nấu nữa nha”

[Chorus - key change up a whole step, stacked harmonies]
Em ơi, thả giỏ xuống đi
Hộp cháo gà, hai viên hạ sốt, một quả cam
Kéo chậm thôi, lần này có thư anh
Em ơi, thả giỏ xuống đi em

[Outro - bell piano, fading]
Ngày thứ ba em hết sốt
Em đi cầu thang xuống, không cần cái giỏ nào

tracks.title: mướp ơi, về nhà đi
tracks.mood: melodramatic and half laughing at itself
tracks.subject: a woman whose cat of four years moves across the alley to the bánh cuốn seller, who feeds it chả lụa, and ignores her calling it home
tracks.caption: Vietnamese Europop in the late-90s Eurodance style. Piano-trance chord stabs cycling i-VI-III-VII; an off-beat octave-jumping bass line; a four-on-the-floor kick with a 909 open hat on every off-beat; hoover and supersaw pad swells under the choruses; a bright pluck arpeggio lead between vocal lines; an eight-bar snare-roll build into each chorus. Bright, glossy and wide, the piano stabs and the lead voice forward, the kick punchy. Female lead, singing the verses plainly in a conversational mid range and climbing to a high, sustained, melodramatic hook line in the chorus, doubled an octave below in the final chorus. 128 BPM, B minor. Melodramatic and half laughing at itself. No rap verse, no Vinahouse pitch-bent bass, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no acoustic ballad section.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - piano-trance stabs and off-beat bass, short]

[Verse 1]
Bốn năm tôi nuôi con Mướp, từ hồi nó bằng nắm tay

tracks.title: con chào mào học hát chèo
tracks.mood: comic and very proud of his own voice
tracks.subject: a man who swears his crested bulbul learned to sing from his chèo, and on contest morning at the village bird café it stays silent until he starts singing himself
tracks.caption: Vietnamese chèo folk-theatre crossover pop with a hip-hop beat. A trống chèo small barrel drum playing the theatre's rolled cues on rim and head; a phách wooden clapper and a small cảnh gong marking accents; a sáo trúc bamboo flute answering each sung phrase with short fills; a đàn nhị two-string fiddle playing a sliding countermelody over a plucked đàn nguyệt ostinato; under them a mid-tempo hip-hop beat with a soft kick and a round sub bass that drops out for a drum-only chèo break. Dry and close like a village stage, the folk instruments forward, the beat sitting underneath. A comic male voice in the chèo clown role, half-spoken and rhythmic in the verses, singing the hook in northern pronunciation with ornamented chèo glides, while a backing chorus shouts short encouraging calls between his lines. 100 BPM, D minor pentatonic. Comic and very proud of his own voice. No trap hi-hat rolls, no autotune, no EDM drop, no rock guitar, no quan họ love duet.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - trống chèo roll and phách, short]

[Verse 1 - half-spoken, comic]
Sáng chủ nhật, quán cà phê chim đầu làng
Ba chục cái lồng treo kín một hàng tre
Lồng tôi treo giữa, phủ khăn nhung đỏ
Con chào mào này ba năm nghe tôi hát chèo

[Chorus - chèo-style hook, chorus shouts]
Chào mào ơi, hót đi con (Hót đi! Hót đi!)
Ba năm tôi hát, mày nghe từng câu
Giọng ai vang từ đầu làng đến chợ (Hay! Hay quá!)
Giọng tôi đấy, mày học của tôi đấy

[Verse 2 - half-spoken, comic]
Ban giám khảo đi qua, lồng ông Bảy hót
Lồng bà Tư hót, lồng cháu ông trưởng thôn cũng hót
Con tôi ngồi im, rỉa lông, nhìn tôi
Như thể ba năm nay người hát dở là tôi

[Chorus - chèo-style hook, chorus shouts]
Chào mào ơi, hót đi con (Hót đi! Hót đi!)
Ba năm tôi hát, mày nghe từng câu
Cả làng đang nhìn, ông trưởng thôn đang cười (Ối giời! Ối giời!)
Hót một câu thôi, tôi bắt cào cào cho

[Bridge - drums only, chèo break]
Tôi đứng lên, hắng giọng, hát một câu chèo
Chào mào nghiêng đầu, rồi hót theo, hót át cả tôi

[Outro - trống chèo roll, a last phách clap]
Giải nhất về chào mào, giải giọng hát về tôi
Ban tổ chức bảo năm nay không có giải ấy

tracks.title: ba vòng xoang
tracks.genre: Tây Nguyên t'rưng and gong EDM
tracks.mood: flirty and breathless, falling for someone in a dance circle
tracks.subject: holding a stranger's hand for three rounds of the xoang circle at a gong festival night in Pleiku, losing her when the circle breaks, and finding her at the rice-wine jar
tracks.caption: Central Highlands Vietnamese festival EDM built on Tây Nguyên bamboo and gong music. A t'rưng hanging bamboo xylophone playing a fast pentatonic ostinato; a cồng chiêng ensemble of bossed and flat gongs in interlocking repeating cycles; k'lông pút bamboo tubes sounded by clapped air as a percussive hook; a four-on-the-floor kick with tribal floor toms; a long festival build into each drop. Roomy and open like a night square around a fire, the gongs and xylophone forward, the kick and sub bass solid underneath. A powerful open-voiced male lead singing long held calls in the manner of Central Highlands sung storytelling, with a crowd chanting the answer lines in unison over the drop. 122 BPM, D major pentatonic. Flirty and breathless, falling for someone in a dance circle. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no supersaw pop chorus, no Western guitar, no chau van fiddle, no Vinahouse pitch-bent bass.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - t'rưng ostinato and one gong cycle, short]

[Verse 1 - long held calls]
Đêm hội cồng chiêng ở Pleiku, lửa giữa sân nhà rông
Vòng xoang mở ra, đứng cạnh ai thì nắm tay người đó
Bên trái tôi là ông già gõ chiêng
Bên phải tôi là em, tay em lạnh, áo em thêu chỉ đỏ

[Pre-Chorus - build]
Chiêng đánh một vòng, mình bước một vòng
Em bảo “chân phải trước”, tôi bước chân trái

[Chorus - drop, crowd chants]
Ba vòng xoang (Ơ hơ!)
Ba vòng rồi tôi chưa hỏi tên em
Tay em ấm dần trong tay tôi (Ơ hơ!)
Ba vòng xoang, chiêng ơi đừng dừng

[Verse 2]
Vòng thứ tư, đoàn khách du lịch chen vào giữa
Vòng xoang đứt làm đôi, em bị cuốn sang bên kia đống lửa
Tôi đi ngược vòng, va ba người, xin lỗi bốn lần
Em ngồi cạnh ché rượu cần, tay cầm hai cái cần

[Chorus - drop, crowd chants]
Ba vòng xoang (Ơ hơ!)
Ba vòng rồi tôi chưa hỏi tên em
Em đưa tôi một cái cần, tay em ấm (Ơ hơ!)
Vòng thứ năm, lần này tôi hỏi tên em

[Outro - gongs alone, the cycle slowing]
Em nói tên em, chiêng to quá
Tôi chưa nghe rõ, nên mình nhảy thêm vòng nữa

metas.prompt: Central Highlands Vietnamese festival EDM built on Tây Nguyên bamboo and gong music. A t'rưng hanging bamboo xylophone playing a fast pentatonic ostinato; a cồng chiêng ensemble of bossed and flat gongs in interlocking repeating cycles; k'lông pút bamboo tubes sounded by clapped air as a percussive hook; a four-on-the-floor kick with tribal floor toms; a long festival build into each drop. Roomy and open like a night square around a fire, the gongs and xylophone forward, the kick and sub bass solid underneath. A powerful open-voiced male lead singing long held calls in the manner of Central Highlands sung storytelling, with a crowd chanting the answer lines in unison over the drop. 122 BPM, D major pentatonic. Flirty and breathless, falling for someone in a dance circle. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no supersaw pop chorus, no Western guitar, no chau van fiddle, no Vinahouse pitch-bent bass.

tracks.title: không có bàn xoay
tracks.mood: proud and cheeky
tracks.subject: a young Bàu Trúc potter who shapes pots by walking backwards around them, answering a tourist who keeps asking where the wheel is
tracks.caption: Vietnamese Chăm festival pop-rap from the south-central coast. A ghi-năng double-headed barrel drum struck by hand on one head and by stick on the other in driving festival patterns; a paranưng frame drum playing syncopations against it; a saranai Chăm shawm with a nasal, reedy tone and circular breathing playing the lead riff between vocal lines; under them a half-time pop-rap beat with a deep 808 and a dry clap. Dry, punchy and close, the drums and the shawm forward, the 808 round and low. A young female voice singing a hook that follows the saranai melody and rapping the verses in a confident, conversational flow, with a small group chanting short answers. 104 BPM, E minor. Proud and cheeky. No trap hi-hat rolls, no autotune, no EDM drop, no Western guitar, no chau van ritual singing, no Bollywood or belly-dance groove.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - saranai riff over ghi-năng and paranưng, short]

[Verse 1 - rap]
Bàu Trúc, nắng trưa, đất sét trộn cát sông Quao
Tôi không có bàn xoay, tôi có hai cái chân
Cái bình đứng yên, tôi đi lùi quanh nó
Một vòng, hai vòng, ba chục vòng, tay vuốt miệng bình

[Pre-Chorus]
Ông khách cầm máy quay, hỏi tới lần thứ ba
“Thế cái bàn xoay để đâu hả em?”

[Chorus - sung, group answers]
Không có bàn xoay (Không có!)
Bàn xoay là tôi, đi lùi từ sáng
Mẹ tôi đi lùi, bà tôi đi lùi (Đi lùi!)
Không có bàn xoay, anh đứng yên mà xem

[Verse 2 - rap]
Ông khách thử một vòng, vấp ngay vào xô nước
Ông cười, tôi cười, cái bình của ông nghiêng sang trái
Tôi bảo bình nghiêng cũng được, nung rơm lên vẫn đỏ
Ông mua luôn cái bình nghiêng, trả gấp đôi

[Chorus - sung, group answers]
Không có bàn xoay (Không có!)
Bàn xoay là tôi, đi lùi từ sáng
Hôm nay thêm một ông khách đi lùi (Đi lùi!)
Không có bàn xoay, mai anh quay lại học

[Outro - saranai alone]
Chiều nay nung gốm ngoài bãi
Ai đi ngang, nhớ đừng hỏi bàn xoay

tracks.title: đừng hắt xì
tracks.mood: breathless and heroic over nothing
tracks.subject: a class monitor called up at the Monday flag ceremony to take the week's top-class emulation banner, thanking the whole school over the microphone while fighting off a sneeze
tracks.caption: Vietnamese anime-opening style pop-rock in the J-pop anisong mould. Overdriven electric guitars playing busy riffs and octave lines; fast sixteenth-note picked electric bass; a live drum kit with crash-heavy fills and a driving eighth-note ride; string-section stabs and bright piano runs between phrases; a chromatic pre-chorus with borrowed chords and a full-band stop one beat before each chorus. Dense, bright and loud, the guitars and strings spread wide, the lead voice clear on top. A clear, high female lead singing fast melodic lines with precise diction, reaching a sustained high note in the chorus, with stacked harmonies behind her. 172 BPM, E major. Breathless and heroic over nothing. No rap verse, no trap drums, no autotune, no EDM drop, no slow ballad intro.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - guitar riff and string stabs, short]

[Verse 1]
Bảy giờ sáng thứ hai, cả trường xếp hàng chào cờ
Tuần này lớp tôi đứng nhất thi đua
Tôi là lớp trưởng, bước lên nhận cờ, cầm micro
Vừa mở miệng, cái mũi bắt đầu ngứa

[Pre-Chorus - chromatic climb]
Một hơi, hai hơi, mắt tôi cay xè
Đừng mà, không phải lúc này

[Chorus - band stops, then everything]
Đừng hắt xì, đừng hắt xì
Cả trường đang nhìn tôi
Cờ thi đua trên tay, micro sát miệng
Mũi ơi, chờ tôi một chút thôi

[Verse 2]
Tôi ấn ngón tay vào nhân trung, như bà dạy hồi nhỏ
Nghĩ tới bài kiểm tra toán, cái mũi vẫn không chịu nghe
Thầy hiệu trưởng nhìn sang, cả lớp tôi nín thở
Tôi nói một hơi không nghỉ: “Lớp mười một A xin cảm ơn”

[Bridge - half-time, strings]
Tôi cúi chào, tay còn cầm micro, quên chưa tắt
“Hắt xì!” một tiếng, vang ra tận cổng trường

[Chorus - final, higher harmonies]
Hắt xì rồi, hắt xì rồi
Cả trường vỗ tay cho tôi
Cờ thi đua trên tay, mặt tôi đỏ hơn cờ
Mũi ơi, cảm ơn đã chờ tôi

[Outro - guitar riff, then a hard stop]
Từ hôm đó, cả trường gọi tôi
“Lớp trưởng hắt xì”

[Song ends abruptly]

tracks.title: 按住講
tracks.mood: cheeky, rambling and very pleased with himself
tracks.subject: a retired grandfather who has just discovered hold-to-talk voice messages and sends seven-minute ones to the family group chat, which everyone answers with a sticker in three seconds
tracks.caption: Temple Street cabaret Cantopop, the working-class 1970s-80s Hong Kong nightclub and street-stall lounge sound. An Electone-style electric organ with rotary vibrato playing off-beat cha-cha chord stabs; a honky-tonk upright piano rolling under the verses; a live cha-cha drum kit with rimshot, cowbell and guiro on the off-beats; a walking electric bass; an alto saxophone answering every vocal phrase, and a single brass hit on each punchline. Roomy but dry, like a small live band in a dance hall, organ and voice forward, saxophone panned right. Older male voice, gravelly and nasal with Cantonese opera training and a wide vibrato, talk-singing the verses with spoken asides, a few backing singers shouting 'hey!' where the lyrics have it, then a belted chorus. 112 BPM, C major. A retired grandfather cheekily proud of his seven-minute voice messages. No hip-hop beat, no rap flow, no EDM, no autotune, no modern pop ballad.

tracks.title: 紫色嗰條
tracks.mood: sheepish, stubborn and finally laughing at himself
tracks.subject: a 34-year-old office worker who spends eight weeks of lunch breaks failing the same purple V3 route at a bouldering wall on the eleventh floor of a Kwun Tong industrial building, until a ten-year-old tops it on her first try and then shows him the heel hook
tracks.caption: Cantonese UK garage pop in the late-1990s London 2-step style. Shuffled 2-step drums with swung sixteenth hi-hats, a skippy kick that avoids beat three and a rimshot snare on two and four with ghost notes; a warbling organ bassline that bends between notes; M1-style organ chord stabs on the off-beats; soft Rhodes seventh chords under the verses; a reverse-cymbal swell into each chorus. Clean and close, low end tight and centred, Rhodes and stabs spread wide, the voice dry and forward. Male voice in his thirties, smooth and light with an R&B lean, sitting slightly behind the beat, light harmonies on the chorus, every hook line sung straight. 132 BPM, F minor. Sheepish and stubborn, an office worker losing to the same purple bouldering route every lunch break and finally laughing at himself. No four-on-the-floor house kick, no drum and bass breakbeat, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no big EDM drop.

tracks.title: 八十七蚊
tracks.mood: petty, furious and funny about money
tracks.subject: chasing four friends since March for the eighty-seven dollars each still owed from a birthday karaoke room you paid for
tracks.caption: Cantonese pop-punk in the fast 2000s pop-punk style. Two overdriven guitars playing palm-muted eighth-note power chords in the verses that open into ringing chords in the chorus; an octave lead-guitar riff between lines; a pick-played bass locked to the kick; double-time snare beats with a crash on every bar of the chorus, and a half-time breakdown on bass and floor tom before the last chorus. Loud, tight and live-sounding, guitars wide left and right, lead voice and gang shouts forward. Young male voice, bright and slightly nasal, singing fast syllabic lines, a gang of friends shouting the 'pay me back' answers written in the lyrics, the last chorus half-shouted. 180 BPM, E major. Petty, furious and funny about eighty-seven dollars. No mid-tempo arena rock, no metal growls, no ballad section, no synths, no autotune.

tracks.title: 隔條涌
tracks.mood: teasing, warm and sunlit
tracks.subject: a Tai O sampan girl and the shrimp-paste maker on the far bank trading teasing lines across the creek all day, each refusing to be the first to cross, until they agree to meet halfway on the fifty-step bridge
tracks.caption: Tanka saltwater song, the Pearl River Delta boat-dwellers' improvised courting duet, in a sparse acoustic folk setting. A plucked qinqin carrying the tune with bright, slightly buzzy notes; a yehu coconut fiddle shadowing the vocal line half a beat behind; a wooden oar knocking a slow, loose pulse on the side of a boat; soft water lapping under everything. Very close and natural, like two people singing across a creek in the open air, voices forward, instruments small and dry, long breaths between lines. A man and a woman trading lines in open-throat folk voices, plain and unpolished, the melody following the speech tones, phrases ending with 'brother' and 'sister' tags, the chorus sung together. 76 BPM, G major pentatonic. Teasing and warm, a morning flirt across the water. No drum kit, no electric bass, no pop ballad strings, no reverb wash, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
大澳條涌 水退咗半截 囉
我喺棚屋門口 曬緊一地蝦醬
對面搖艇仔嗰個 妹呀
你今朝條辮 綁到咁高做乜

[Pre-Chorus]
哥呀 你啲蝦醬 臭晒成條涌
我條辮綁高 費事黐到你啲味

[Chorus]
隔條涌 隔條涌
你唔過嚟 我唔過去
橋就喺隔籬 得五十步
睇邊個 先頂唔順 囉

[Verse]
哥呀 你成日望過嚟 望足十轉
蝦醬未收 落雨你又唔理
人哋搭我條艇 問我笑乜
我話對面 有個傻佬 曬蝦醬 囉

[Pre-Chorus]
妹呀 我留咗一樽 最香嗰樽
你過嚟攞 我就唔收你錢

[Chorus]
隔條涌 隔條涌
你唔過嚟 我唔過去
橋就喺隔籬 得五十步
一樽蝦醬 等你過嚟攞 囉

[Bridge]
妹呀 夜晚收工 你過唔過嚟
哥呀 要過 你自己過
咁就一人行一半 喺橋中間等 囉

[Chorus]
隔條涌 隔條涌
你行廿五步 我行廿五步
五十步 行咗成個鐘
你隻手 仲有陣蝦醬味 囉

[Outro]
哥呀
聽朝記得 搭我條船

tracks.title: 落水啦
tracks.mood: sun-drunk, sassy and teasing
tracks.subject: eight friends on a Saturday junk boat and the one who will not get in the water until someone inflates her giant flamingo
tracks.caption: Cantonese moombahton pop sung by a four-girl group, the Dutch-house-meets-reggaeton club sound. A dembow kick and reggaeton snare in the boom-ch-boom-chk pattern; detuned Dutch-house synth stabs on the off-beats; a nylon-string Latin guitar plucking the riff in the verses; timbales and conga fills at the ends of phrases; brass stabs and an electric guitar doubling the accented chorus lines in the drop. Punchy and bright, dembow and bass forward, guitar and stabs wide, voices close. Four young female voices, half-spoken and confident in the verses, unison on the chorus hooks, short chanted counts sung live as written. 108 BPM, A minor. Sun-drunk and teasing on a hired boat. No four-on-the-floor kick, no trap hi-hat rolls, no Afrobeats shaker groove, no ballad bridge, no slow romantic reggaeton-pop, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
禮拜六 中環九號碼頭 集合
八個女仔 一架遊艇 兩箱啤酒
阿Mandy 戴住太陽眼鏡 戴住帽
仲帶埋一隻 未吹脹嘅火烈鳥

[Pre-Chorus]
船停喺牛尾海 個個除衫就跳
得佢一個 坐喺船頭 唔郁

[Chorus]
落水啦 落水啦 Mandy
佢話 火烈鳥未吹脹 我唔落
落水啦 落水啦 Mandy
一、二、三！ 嗌到成隻船都震

[Verse]
我哋輪流吹 吹到頭都暈
船家阿叔 攞個泵出嚟幫手
隻雀吹到 差唔多大過隻船
Mandy 戴好眼鏡 終於企起身

[Pre-Chorus]
佢行到船邊 擺好個pose
叫我哋影多十張 先至跳

[Chorus]
落水啦 落水啦 Mandy
影完十張 仲要揀相揀半個鐘
落水啦 落水啦 Mandy
一、二、三！ 佢終於跳落去

[Bridge]
撲通！ 水花濺到船家阿叔
火烈鳥 自己飄咗出去
Mandy 喺水度大叫 返嚟呀

[Chorus]
落水啦 落水啦 姊妹
而家輪到佢 求我哋落去追
游啦 游啦 八個女仔
一、二、三！ 追住隻雀游出公海

[Outro]
返到碼頭 個個曬到紅晒
隻火烈鳥 而家喺牛尾海 自己玩緊

tracks.title: 每月十號
tracks.mood: gloomy, self-mocking and finally a little free
tracks.subject: a two-year gym contract signed on impulse and used four times, and the monthly deduction kept up as proof you still mean to change, until the last one on the tenth of October
tracks.caption: Cantonese emo rap in the bedroom-pop-leaning Hong Kong underground style. A looped clean electric-guitar arpeggio through a chorus pedal, lo-fi and slightly warped; an 808 sub-bass with slow pitch glides; half-time trap hi-hats with occasional triplet rolls; sparse dry claps; filtered room noise under a bare guitar-only intro and outro. Dry, narrow and intimate, guitar loop and voice forward, low end soft. Young female voice, half-sung and half-rapped, deadpan and melancholy, mumbled confessional verses lifting into a doubled melodic chorus. 140 BPM, C# minor. Gloomy, self-mocking and finally a little free. No boom bap drums, no drill bounce, no EDM drop, no rock band, no autotune, no pitch-corrected warble.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
每月十號 四百八十八 準時扣數
張合約兩年 前年十月 一時衝動簽
我話明年夏天 要有腹肌 去沙灘
去咗四次 第五次 落咗雨

[Pre-Chorus]
我打去取消 佢話要親身去
親身去 即係要著返對波鞋

[Chorus]
每月十號 叮一聲 又扣咗
四百八十八 買我仲未放棄
一直冇去 張卡仲喺銀包
每月十號 我仲係想變

[Verse]
朋友叫我 轉個會籍畀人
我話唔得 我下個禮拜就去
下個禮拜 變咗下個月
下個月 變咗下年先算

[Pre-Chorus]
我IG follow咗 十個健身教練
睇佢哋舉重 我喺床度食薯片

[Chorus]
每月十號 叮一聲 又扣咗
四百八十八 買我仲未放棄
佢哋喺鏡頭前面 數到十二下
我喺被竇入面 數仲有幾多期

[Bridge]
今日 十月十號
叮 最後一期
原來放棄 都係四百八十八

[Chorus]
每月十號 冇再叮 冇再扣
四百八十八 留返自己食餐好
張會員卡 夾咗喺書入面
每月十號 我唔使再扮

[Outro]
今晚我自己 落樓下公園
跑咗五分鐘 就唞唔到氣 但係冇錢扣

tracks.caption: Cantonese stadium games anthem in the style of a Hong Kong sports-games theme song. A trumpet and French-horn fanfare opening each chorus; timpani rolls into every section; a rudimental marching snare under a stadium kick and stacked hand-claps; a driving octave piano; a string ostinato under the verses; a massed SATB choir doubling the chorus, and a half-step key change into the last chorus. Big and roomy like an open-air riverside race, choir and brass wide, lead voices forward. Several middle-aged female lead voices trading lines in the verses, then all in unison with the full choir on the chorus, an open, stubborn belt, crowd shouts of 'one, two, paddle' as written in the lyrics. 124 BPM, Bb major rising to B major. Proud, loud and stubborn in the final. No EDM drop, no synth build, no trap beat, no rap, no autotune.

tracks.title: 大閘蟹
tracks.genre: Cantonese opera aria with modern orchestra
tracks.mood: mock-heroic panic, then relief
tracks.subject: meeting a girlfriend's father for the first time over a hairy crab dinner in a restaurant private room and sending a crab leg flying out of the private-room door
tracks.caption: Cantonese opera aria with modern orchestra, a newly written comic aria in the Guangdong opera style. A gaohu leading the melody with sliding ornaments; a yangqin shimmering in tremolo; a plucked qinqin; a suona for the climaxes; wooden clappers and a wooden fish keeping the beat, with gong-and-cymbal punctuation at each section change; a soft modern string-orchestra pad underneath. Theatrical and roomy like a concert hall, gaohu and voice forward, percussion crisp, strings low. Male voice in pinghou natural chest voice, operatic Cantonese with ornamented melismas on held vowels, a comic mock-heroic delivery; opens in free rhythm, then settles into a steady middle-tempo beat. 84 BPM, F major. Mock-heroic panic over a hairy crab, then relief. No pop drum kit, no rock guitar, no Western pop ballad singing, no electronic beat, no Peking opera falsetto, no Mandarin Chinese-style pop, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
今晚初次 拜見佢老豆
酒樓房內 十個人 一圍坐定
侍應捧上 一碟大閘蟹
八足雙鉗 草繩綁實 望住我

[Pre-Chorus]
佢老豆一聲 食啦
成枱十雙眼 齊齊望住我隻手

[Chorus]
蟹呀蟹 你我今晚 一決高低
鉗仔剪刀擺滿枱 我唔知用邊件
蟹呀蟹 你唔好怪我無情
搞得掂你 我先搞得掂佢老豆

[Verse]
揭開蟹蓋 蟹膏濺到佢阿媽件衫
蟹腳一拗 飛咗出房門口
女朋友喺枱底 踢我一腳
細細聲講 蟹肺唔食得㗎

[Pre-Chorus]
佢老豆放低筷子 一聲都唔出
成間房靜到 聽到蟹鉗跌落地

[Chorus]
蟹呀蟹 你我今晚 一決高低
鉗仔剪刀擺滿枱 我唔知用邊件
蟹呀蟹 你唔好怪我無情
你個殼硬 佢老豆塊面仲硬

[Bridge]
點知佢老豆 突然拎起一隻蟹腳
教我由呢度撳落去 輕輕一拗
成條蟹肉 完完整整出嚟

[Chorus]
蟹呀蟹 你我今晚 一決高低
佢老豆坐埋嚟 一隻隻教我拆
蟹呀蟹 多謝你犧牲咗
佢話下年蟹季 記得再嚟

[Outro]
伯父 你話下年
即係 我仲有下年

tracks.mood: steady, quietly devoted and warm
tracks.subject: a church volunteer driving a seven-seater van round three housing estates every Sunday morning to collect five elderly members, waiting for each of them
tracks.caption: Cantonese contemporary worship ballad in the Hong Kong praise-band style. Ambient synth pad swells; an electric guitar riff with dotted-eighth delay; a strummed steel-string acoustic guitar; a piano carrying plain hymn chords; floor toms swelling into a full band at the bridge, then dropping to piano and voices before the last chorus. Warm and spacious, pad and delay guitar wide, lead voice forward and close. Male lead, earnest and plain in a congregational range with no wide leaps, worship-team harmonies and a small choir joining on the chorus and the bridge. 74 BPM, A major. Steady, quietly devoted and warm. No gospel Hammond organ, no soul melisma runs, no EDM drop, no trap beat, no autotune.

tracks.title: 拍拖未呀
tracks.genre: Cantonese Lunar New Year festive pop
tracks.mood: festive, cheeky and chaotic
tracks.subject: doing the round of eleven relatives' flats on the second day of Lunar New Year and being asked 'are you seeing anyone yet?' at every door, with a different dodge ready for each
tracks.caption: Cantonese Lunar New Year festive pop in the Hong Kong family-singalong party style. A suona playing the lead melody in major pentatonic; a lion-dance big drum with gongs and crash cymbals on the chorus downbeats; a four-on-the-floor kick with slap bass; guzheng glissandi sweeping into each chorus; bright brass stabs and a firecracker crackle between sections. Bright, loud and crowded, drums and suona forward, brass wide. A smiling mixed group of male and female voices singing in unison, spoken New Year greetings between lines and shouted crowd answers as written in the lyrics. 128 BPM, D major. Festive, cheeky and chaotic, dodging the same question at every door. No minor-key ballad, no cinematic orchestral strings, no trap beat, no rap verse, no EDM build or drop, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
年初二 朝早十點 新衫新褲
阿媽排好路線 十一個單位 一日行晒
第一家 三姑媽 未入門口就問
乖仔 今年 有冇女朋友呀

[Pre-Chorus]
我塞粒糖蓮子 入口 慢慢咬

[Chorus]

tracks.title: 我早就放手了
tracks.mood: giddy, falling for her three laps in
tracks.subject: teaching a twenty-six-year-old to ride a shared bike in an empty supermarket car park at night, and letting go of the seat three laps before she notices
tracks.caption: Mandarin melodic future-bass EDM pop in the build-and-drop style of current Chinese festival electronic music. Detuned supersaw chord stacks pumping hard against a sidechained kick; future-bass chord stabs with an LFO wobbling the filter and the volume; a bright detuned synth lead carrying the melody in each drop; a deep 808 sub under the chords; half-time drop drums with the clap on three and trap-style hi-hat rolls, a snare-roll riser and white-noise sweep into every drop, and a breakdown that falls back to solo piano. Close and intimate in the verses, wide and pumping in the drops, the voice forward and the supersaws spread wide behind it. Male voice, a clean close-miked tenor with breath in it, soft in the verses and opening up in the chorus. 150 BPM with a half-time feel, F major. Giddy, falling for her three laps in. No four-on-the-floor house kick, no 80s analog synthpop, no rap verse, no trap beat under the verses, no chopped-up voice snippets in the drops, no guitar, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - short, solo piano with a filtered supersaw swelling underneath]

[Verse 1]
超市關門以後 停車場只剩一排路燈
妳掃了一台共享單車 說今天一定要學會
二十六歲 第一次騎 手抓得比握方向盤還緊
我在後面扶著坐墊 跑得比妳還喘

[Pre-Chorus - snare roll builds]
妳一直喊 不要放手 不要放手
我說好 我在 我在後面

[Chorus]
我早就放手了
從B區騎到C區 妳一個人騎了三圈
妳還在喊不要放手 頭都不敢回
我站在原地 突然捨不得叫妳

[Drop - half-time supersaw stabs, a bright synth lead plays the chorus melody]

[Verse 2]
妳終於回頭 看見我在三十公尺外
車頭一歪 直直撞進那一排購物車
保全拿著手電筒 從另一頭跑過來
妳坐在地上笑 說 你騙我

[Pre-Chorus - snare roll builds]
妳問我 你什麼時候放的
我說 第二圈 妳開始哼歌的時候

[Chorus]
我早就放手了
從B區騎到C區 妳一個人騎了三圈
妳拍拍膝蓋上的灰 說明天還要再來
我站在原地 這一次 換我放不下了

[Drop - half-time supersaw stabs and synth lead]

[Outro - solo piano, the supersaw fading]
停車場的燈 一盞一盞關了
妳伸手過來 說 這次換你不要放手

tracks.title: 三二七號是我
tracks.mood: seven unlucky years, one loud night
tracks.subject: a customer-service rep who finally wins the top prize at her company's eighties-themed annual-party lucky draw after seven years of 'thanks for taking part'
tracks.caption: 1980s mainland Chinese disco revival in the Zhang Qiang dance-hall style. An octave-jumping slap electric bass on every eighth note; DX7-style FM brass stabs and a bell-toned FM electric piano; a bright string pad sweeping up into each chorus; a chicken-scratch clean guitar on the sixteenths; syndrum and tom fills at the ends of phrases; drums with a four-on-the-floor kick, an open hi-hat on every offbeat and handclaps on two and four. Bright, slightly thin 1980s cassette sound, mid-range forward, the bass and the voice up front with a light plate reverb. Female voice, bright, sweet and a little nasal, with a quick vibrato and a teasing, playful delivery; a group of mixed office voices shouting the short answers. 122 BPM, D major. Seven unlucky years, one loud night. No Y2K eurodance, no Japanese city pop chords, no trap drums, no modern EDM drop, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - short, slap bass octaves, FM brass stab, handclaps]

[Verse 1]
公司年會 今年主題是八〇年代
經理穿了喇叭褲 前台戴著一副大眼鏡
我坐最後一桌 離廁所最近那一桌
七年了 我抽到的 都是謝謝參與

[Pre-Chorus]
一等獎 是一台雙開門的大冰箱
老闆把手伸進紅箱子 攪了好久好久

[Chorus]
三二七號 是我 (嘿!)
三二七號 是我是我
我踩著高跟鞋 從廁所旁邊衝上台
整個宴會廳都在喊 (三二七!)

[Verse 2]
老闆說 得獎的人要陪他跳一支舞
燈球開始轉 DJ放了一首迪斯科
我拉著老闆轉了三圈 他的假髮歪到一邊
台下的同事 全部舉著手機在拍

[Pre-Chorus]
冰箱太大 我家根本放不下
我說沒關係 先搬到我們客服部

[Chorus]
三二七號 是我 (嘿!)
三二七號 是我是我
七年的謝謝參與 今天一次還給我
明年年會 我要坐第一桌 (第一桌!)

[Outro - FM brass and string pad, handclaps fading]
冰箱放在客服部 門上貼了我的名字
誰要喝冰可樂 先叫我一聲姐 (姐!)

tracks.title: 這個瓜妳敲過三遍了
tracks.mood: flirty roadside haggling in the heat
tracks.subject: a melon grower at his roadside stall outside Turpan and the woman on an e-bike who knocks every melon on the pile and still won't buy
tracks.caption: Xinjiang folk-pop in the Daolang style, built on a Uyghur dance groove. A dap frame drum played by hand in a driving dum-tek dance pattern, doubled by tambourine; a plucked dutar ostinato in a muqam-flavoured mode with an augmented second; an accordion answering each vocal line; a violin obbligato sliding between phrases; a pop kit with the snare on two and four over a warm synth pad. Warm and roomy like a roadside wedding band, the frame drum and the voices forward, the dutar wide. Male voice, a husky, weathered baritone with declamatory phrasing and melismatic turns on held notes; a bright female voice sings every answering line. 116 BPM, D minor. Flirty roadside haggling in the heat. No free-rhythm hua'er calls, no erhu, no guzheng, no banhu, no suona, no trap drums, no EDM synths, no rock distortion, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - short, frame drum dance pattern and dutar ostinato]

[Verse 1 - Male]
出了吐魯番三十公里 瓜攤搭在白楊樹下

妳把電動車停在路邊 安全帽也不拿下
一個一個敲過去 像醫生在聽心跳

[Chorus - Male, female answers]
這個瓜妳敲過三遍了

妳要不要切開看看 刀我已經擦乾淨了

[Chorus - Male, female answers]
這個瓜妳敲過三遍了

我坐回樹蔭下 敲了敲自己的頭

tracks.title: 阿龍是誰
tracks.mood: laid-back jealousy that boils over, then melts
tracks.subject: a girlfriend's grey parrot that bites only him and greets him with her ex-boyfriend's name
tracks.caption: Mandarin reggae-rock in the style of the Nanning band Mr Chelonian. A clean electric guitar skank, a muted upstroke chop on two and four; a melodic dub-style bass line wandering under the verses; an organ bubble on the offbeats; spring reverb and delay throws on the snare and the skank; distorted rock power chords crashing in for every chorus. Drums play a one-drop groove in the verses, kick and rimshot on three, and switch to a straight rock beat in the choruses. Warm, humid and roomy, the bass forward in the verses and the guitars wide in the choruses. Male voice, a warm, slightly raspy baritone, laid-back and conversational in the verses, breaking into a shouted rock chorus. 84 BPM, A minor. Laid-back jealousy that boils over, then melts. No dancehall riddim, no Jamaican patois, no trap drums, no EDM synths, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - short, skank guitar, organ bubble, one dub bass note]

[Verse 1]
她家陽台 掛著一個竹子編的鳥籠
裡面那隻灰鸚鵡 她養得比我們在一起還久
我拿香蕉給牠 牠咬我的手指
我一進門 牠就喊 阿龍你回來啦

[Pre-Chorus]
我問她 阿龍是誰
她說 一個朋友 低頭繼續剝她的橘子

[Chorus - distorted guitars, shouted]
阿龍是誰
為什麼牠一看到我 就喊阿龍
阿龍是誰
我腳上這雙拖鞋 是不是他的

[Verse 2]
後來我每天下班 帶一顆葡萄給牠
第二十一天 牠沒咬我 跳到我的肩膀上
牠在我耳邊 很小聲地說了兩個字
不是阿龍 是我的名字

[Pre-Chorus]
她從廚房跑出來 手上都是洗碗精
她說 我教了牠一個月 你不准笑

[Chorus - distorted guitars, shouted]
阿龍是誰
現在我一點都不想知道了
阿龍是誰
那雙拖鞋 明天我自己買一雙新的

[Outro - one-drop drums, spring reverb throws]
籠子裡那隻鸚鵡 一直喊我的名字
喊到對面樓的人 都探出頭來

tracks.mood: frantic, triumphant and a little broke
tracks.subject: a college student ninety pulls into a gacha banner at midnight in her dorm, three roommates leaning out of their bed curtains to watch
tracks.caption: Chinese ACG anime-rock in the fast story-song style of Chinese anime and mobile-game theme songs, sung by a human singer. Double-tracked overdriven guitars on fast power chords; sixteenth-note piano arpeggios running under every verse; a busy, slap-inflected electric bass; driving eighth-note drums with a crash on every bar downbeat, stop-and-hit unison breaks, a half-time pre-chorus and a key change up a whole step into the last chorus. Bright, compressed and dense, the guitars wide, the piano and the voice forward. Female voice, bright and high in an anime-idol timbre, very fast syllable runs with tight pitch, spoken character lines for the roommates, and a small group shouting the countdown answers. 176 BPM, B minor. Frantic, triumphant and a little broke. No trap drums, no EDM drop, no ballad section, no dizi or erhu, no robotic synthesized voice, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - short, guitar riff and piano arpeggio, crash on every bar]

[Verse 1]
半夜十二點零一分 新卡池開了
宿舍四張床 三顆頭從床簾裡探出來
這個月的飯錢 全部換成了鑽石
十連抽 十連抽 再來一個十連抽
藍的 藍的 藍的 紫的 又是藍的

[Pre-Chorus - half-time]
小美說 妳冷靜一點
阿婷說 妳明天吃什麼
我說別吵 計數器上寫著八十九

[Chorus]
再一抽就保底了
我把手機舉到窗邊 拜一拜月亮
再一抽就保底了
三個室友一起倒數 (三 二 一!)

[Verse 2]
金光一閃 整間宿舍都亮了
歪了 出來一個常駐的 我早就有了
小美笑到從上舖滾下來 阿婷在錄影
我盯著屏幕 一句話都說不出來

[Break - stop-and-hit unison band hits]
等一下 等一下
原來這只是 小保底

[Chorus - key change up a whole step]
再九十抽就保底了
我把下個月的飯錢 也拿出來算
再九十抽就保底了
三個室友 一人借我一百 (一百!)

[Outro - guitars ring out, spoken]
泡麵我請
抽到了 換我請妳們吃火鍋

tracks.caption: Chinese-language original musical theatre show tune, a comic duet in the Shanghai small-theatre style. A pit orchestra led by piano; a string section underscoring the recitative; clarinet and flute trading quick answering figures between the two singers; a French horn swelling under the last chorus and timpani hits on each dramatic turn; a light kit played with brushes that drops out for the recitative and for the slower final chorus. tracks.caption: Chinese hyperpop and 土嗨 glitch-pop in the style of DJ Gurl's county-town club collage. Over-compressed, distorted 808s that clip on every hit; bitcrushed supersaw chords; stutter and glitch edits on the synths and drums at the end of each phrase; old instant-messenger notification blips and dial-up modem noise used as percussion; drums that switch hard between a pounding club four-on-the-floor kick and trap hi-hat rolls, with bursts of static between sections. Loud, crushed and in-your-face, the low end blown out and narrow, the voice dry and forward. Female voice, high and bright with hard digital pitch correction, rapping the verses fast and flat, shouting the chorus like a county-fair MC with audible breaths, and a small crowd shouting the one-word answers. 160 BPM, F-sharp minor. Chaotic, greedy and stuck at ninety-nine point nine. No clean eurodance, no acoustic guitar, no ballad piano, no smooth R&B, no rock band, no straight trap beat in the choruses, no pitched-up voice samples, no chopped-up voice snippets.

tracks.title: 翻個面
tracks.mood: sly, steamy and satirical
tracks.subject: a Harbin bathhouse scrubber who has scrubbed the factory director and the factory gatekeeper for thirty years and says their backs look exactly the same
tracks.caption: Northeastern Chinese folk-tune storytelling pop. A bright, nasal banhu fiddle playing the lead tune and answering each line; suona fills at the end of each verse; bamboo clappers clacking on every beat; a cheap electronic stage keyboard pumping the chords like a village folk-opera troupe; an electric bass bouncing on one and three; a dry pop kit with handclaps and call-and-response stops. Dry and close like the back room of an old bathhouse, the banhu and the voice forward, a small group chorus behind. Male voice, a gravelly, nasal baritone, half-sung and half-recited in a sly, satirical storyteller delivery with Northeastern speech rhythm, and a small group chorus shouting the answers. 120 BPM, G major. Sly, steamy and satirical. No guzheng, no Peking opera falsetto, no free-rhythm hua'er calls, no accordion, no frame drum, no dutar, no trap drums, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - short, banhu tune over bamboo clappers]

[Verse 1]
哈爾濱道外 老澡堂子 熱氣冒到大馬路上
搓澡的老孫 一條搓澡巾 搓了三十年
進門的人 有的坐小轎車 有的騎二八大槓
衣服一脫 鑰匙往手腕上一套 誰也不認識誰

[Chorus - group answers]
來 翻個面 (翻個面!)
廠長的後背 跟看大門的老王 一個樣
來 翻個面 (翻個面!)
搓下來的泥 也沒比誰多一兩

[Verse 2]
有一回廠長來了 倆秘書在門口等著
他說老孫 你給我好好搓 明天我要上台講話
老孫說 你趴好 你這肚子 比你們廠的庫存還多
廠長嘿嘿一笑 說你這張嘴 比你那毛巾還狠

[Chorus - group answers]
來 翻個面 (翻個面!)
廠長的後背 跟看大門的老王 一個樣
來 翻個面 (翻個面!)
出了這個門 你再接著當你的廠長

[Bridge - clappers and handclaps only, call and response]
水熱不熱 (熱!)
勁大不大 (大!)
二十塊錢 (值!)

[Outro - suona fill, banhu closes the tune]
老孫說 我這輩子沒記住誰的臉
後背倒是 一個都沒忘

tracks.title: 坡上有一格
tracks.mood: tender, cold and happily married
tracks.subject: a Kazakh herder at the winter pasture who climbs the slope behind the house at nine every night for one bar of signal to call his wife in town
tracks.caption: Solo nylon-string steppe folk in the Kazakh style of Mamer's solo recordings, sung in Mandarin. One fingerpicked nylon-string guitar, played loosely and often rubato, with the open low strings droning under the melody; dombra-style strummed triplet figures on the same guitar between sung lines; knuckle taps on the guitar body as the only percussion; wordless humming over the strums in the interlude. Close, dry and intimate like one man in a small room, the guitar and the voice forward, breaths audible. Male voice, low, gentle and contemplative, with small steppe-style ornaments on held notes. 76 BPM, E minor. Tender, cold and happily married. No drums, no full band, no strummed steel-string city folk, no morin khuur, no gallop rhythm, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - four bars, fingerpicked nylon guitar over an open low drone, knuckle taps]

[Verse 1]
晚上九點 我把爐子裡的火捅旺一點
披上那件羊皮大衣 往屋後的坡上走
狗跟在後面 雪埋到膝蓋
走到那塊黑石頭 手機才有一格

[Chorus]
喂 我在坡上 有一格
妳先說 妳先說 我這邊風大
說兒子考了第幾名 說縣城下雪沒有
說什麼都好 我在聽

[Interlude - wordless humming over dombra-style strummed triplets]

[Verse 2]
我說今天又生了兩隻小羊 一黑一白
黑的那隻站不起來 我抱進屋裡 放在爐子邊
妳笑我 說我對羊比對妳還好
風把妳的笑 吹斷了一半

[Chorus]
喂 我在坡上 還有一格
妳再說一次 妳再說一次 我這邊風大
妳說等開春 帶兒子上山來看我
我說好 黑的那隻 我留給他

[Outro - guitar alone, rubato, one knuckle tap]
下坡的時候 訊號沒了
我還是對著手機 把那句話說完了
